name: ISO/IEC 27001:2022
description: Information security management systems. Includes the mandatory management-system clauses (4-10) as well as the 93 Annex A controls, because certification turns on the clauses and a tool that models only Annex A cannot tell you whether you are certifiable. Control titles are the standard's own short labels; descriptive text is paraphrased - see NOTICE.md.

requirements.title: Understanding the organization and its context
requirements.text: Determine external and internal issues relevant to the purpose of the organization that affect the ISMS.

requirements.title: Interested parties and their requirements
requirements.text: Determine interested parties relevant to the ISMS and their information security requirements, including legal and regulatory obligations.

requirements.title: Scope of the ISMS
requirements.text: Determine and document the boundaries and applicability of the ISMS.

requirements.title: Information security management system
requirements.text: Establish, implement, maintain and continually improve the ISMS, including the processes needed and their interactions.

requirements.title: Leadership and commitment
requirements.text: Top management demonstrates leadership and commitment to the ISMS, including ensuring resources and integrating requirements into business processes.

requirements.title: Information security policy
requirements.text: Establish an information security policy appropriate to the organization, communicated internally and available to interested parties as appropriate.

requirements.title: Organizational roles, responsibilities and authorities
requirements.text: Assign and communicate responsibilities and authorities for roles relevant to information security.

requirements.title: Actions to address risks and opportunities — general
requirements.text: Determine risks and opportunities needing to be addressed to ensure the ISMS achieves its intended outcomes and to prevent undesired effects.

requirements.title: Information security risk assessment
requirements.text: Define and apply a repeatable risk assessment process with risk acceptance criteria, producing consistent, valid and comparable results.

requirements.title: Information security risk treatment
requirements.text: Define and apply a risk treatment process, select controls, compare against Annex A to verify no necessary control has been omitted, and produce a Statement of Applicability and a risk treatment plan with owner approval and acceptance of residual risk.

requirements.title: Information security objectives and planning
requirements.text: Establish measurable information security objectives consistent with the policy, and plan how they will be achieved, monitored and evaluated.

requirements.title: Planning of changes
requirements.text: Carry out changes to the ISMS in a planned manner.

requirements.title: Resources
requirements.text: Determine and provide the resources needed for the ISMS.

requirements.title: Competence
requirements.text: Determine, ensure and retain evidence of the competence of persons whose work affects information security performance.

requirements.title: Awareness
requirements.text: Ensure relevant persons are aware of the policy, their contribution to the ISMS and the implications of not conforming.

requirements.title: Communication
requirements.text: Determine the internal and external communications relevant to the ISMS — what, when, with whom and how.

requirements.title: Documented information
requirements.text: Create, update and control documented information required by the standard and needed for ISMS effectiveness, including availability, protection and version control.

requirements.title: Operational planning and control
requirements.text: Plan, implement and control the processes needed to meet information security requirements and retain documented information to show processes ran as planned.

requirements.title: Information security risk assessment (operation)
requirements.text: Perform risk assessments at planned intervals and when significant changes occur, retaining documented results.

requirements.title: Information security risk treatment (operation)
requirements.text: Implement the risk treatment plan and retain documented results.

requirements.title: Monitoring, measurement, analysis and evaluation
requirements.text: Evaluate information security performance and ISMS effectiveness, defining what is monitored, by which methods, when and by whom.

requirements.title: Internal audit
requirements.text: Conduct internal audits at planned intervals against an audit programme to confirm conformity with the organization's own requirements and the standard.

requirements.title: Management review
requirements.text: Top management reviews the ISMS at planned intervals, covering defined inputs including audit results, risk status and improvement opportunities.

requirements.title: Continual improvement
requirements.text: Continually improve the suitability, adequacy and effectiveness of the ISMS.

requirements.title: Nonconformity and corrective action
requirements.text: React to nonconformities, evaluate the need to eliminate their causes, implement corrective action and retain documented evidence of the outcome.

requirements.title: Policies for information security
requirements.text: Define, approve, publish, communicate and periodically review an information security policy and topic-specific policies.

requirements.title: Information security roles and responsibilities
requirements.text: Define and allocate information security roles and responsibilities according to organizational needs.

requirements.title: Segregation of duties
requirements.text: Segregate conflicting duties and areas of responsibility.

requirements.title: Management responsibilities
requirements.text: Management requires all personnel to apply information security in accordance with established policies and procedures.

requirements.title: Contact with authorities
requirements.text: Establish and maintain contact with relevant authorities.

requirements.title: Contact with special interest groups
requirements.text: Establish and maintain contact with special interest groups, security forums and professional associations.

requirements.title: Threat intelligence
requirements.text: Collect and analyse information on information security threats to produce actionable threat intelligence.

requirements.title: Information security in project management
requirements.text: Integrate information security into project management.

requirements.title: Inventory of information and other associated assets
requirements.text: Develop and maintain an inventory of information and other associated assets, including owners.

requirements.title: Acceptable use of information and other associated assets
requirements.text: Identify, document and implement rules for the acceptable use and handling of information and associated assets.

requirements.title: Return of assets
requirements.text: Personnel and other interested parties return organizational assets on change or termination of their employment, contract or agreement.

requirements.title: Classification of information
requirements.text: Classify information according to the organization's information security needs based on confidentiality, integrity, availability and relevant requirements.

requirements.title: Labelling of information
requirements.text: Develop and implement procedures for labelling information in accordance with the classification scheme.

requirements.title: Information transfer
requirements.text: Put transfer rules, procedures and agreements in place for all types of transfer facilities.

requirements.title: Access control
requirements.text: Establish and implement rules to control physical and logical access to information and associated assets based on business and security requirements.

requirements.title: Identity management
requirements.text: Manage the full life cycle of identities.

requirements.title: Authentication information
requirements.text: Control the allocation and management of authentication information, advising personnel on appropriate handling.

requirements.title: Access rights
requirements.text: Provision, review, modify and remove access rights in accordance with the access control policy.

requirements.title: Information security in supplier relationships
requirements.text: Define and implement processes and procedures to manage information security risks associated with the use of suppliers' products or services.

requirements.title: Addressing information security within supplier agreements
requirements.text: Establish and agree relevant information security requirements with each supplier.

requirements.title: Managing information security in the ICT supply chain
requirements.text: Define and implement processes to manage information security risks associated with the ICT products and services supply chain.

requirements.title: Monitoring, review and change management of supplier services
requirements.text: Regularly monitor, review, evaluate and manage change in supplier information security practice and service delivery.

requirements.title: Information security for use of cloud services
requirements.text: Establish processes for acquisition, use, management and exit from cloud services in accordance with security requirements.

requirements.title: Information security incident management planning and preparation
requirements.text: Plan and prepare for incident management by defining, establishing and communicating processes, roles and responsibilities.

requirements.title: Assessment and decision on information security events
requirements.text: Assess information security events and decide whether they are to be categorised as information security incidents.

requirements.title: Response to information security incidents
requirements.text: Respond to information security incidents in accordance with documented procedures.

requirements.title: Learning from information security incidents
requirements.text: Use knowledge gained from incidents to strengthen and improve controls.

requirements.title: Collection of evidence
requirements.text: Establish and implement procedures for the identification, collection, acquisition and preservation of evidence relating to information security events.

requirements.title: Information security during disruption
requirements.text: Plan how to maintain information security at an appropriate level during disruption.

requirements.title: ICT readiness for business continuity
requirements.text: Plan, implement, maintain and test ICT readiness based on business continuity objectives and ICT continuity requirements.

requirements.title: Legal, statutory, regulatory and contractual requirements
requirements.text: Identify, document and keep up to date legal, statutory, regulatory and contractual requirements relevant to information security, and the approach to meeting them.

requirements.title: Intellectual property rights
requirements.text: Implement appropriate procedures to protect intellectual property rights.

requirements.title: Protection of records
requirements.text: Protect records from loss, destruction, falsification, unauthorised access and unauthorised release.

requirements.title: Privacy and protection of PII
requirements.text: Identify and meet requirements regarding the preservation of privacy and protection of personally identifiable information according to applicable law and contract.

requirements.title: Independent review of information security
requirements.text: Review the organization's approach to managing information security independently at planned intervals and when significant changes occur.

requirements.title: Compliance with policies, rules and standards for information security
requirements.text: Regularly review compliance with the organization's information security policy, topic-specific policies, rules and standards.

requirements.title: Documented operating procedures
requirements.text: Document operating procedures for information processing facilities and make them available to personnel who need them.

requirements.title: Screening
requirements.text: Carry out background verification checks on all candidates before joining and on an ongoing basis, considering applicable law, ethics and risk.

requirements.title: Terms and conditions of employment
requirements.text: Employment contractual agreements state the personnel's and the organization's responsibilities for information security.

requirements.title: Information security awareness, education and training
requirements.text: Provide personnel and relevant interested parties with appropriate awareness, education and training, and regular updates on policies and procedures relevant to their role.

requirements.title: Disciplinary process
requirements.text: Formalise and communicate a disciplinary process to take action against personnel and other interested parties who violate the information security policy.

requirements.title: Responsibilities after termination or change of employment
requirements.text: Define, enforce and communicate information security responsibilities that remain valid after termination or change of employment.

requirements.title: Confidentiality or non-disclosure agreements
requirements.text: Identify, document, regularly review and have signed by personnel and other relevant parties confidentiality or non-disclosure agreements.

requirements.title: Remote working
requirements.text: Implement security measures where personnel work remotely to protect information accessed, processed or stored outside the organization's premises.

requirements.title: Information security event reporting
requirements.text: Provide a mechanism for personnel to report observed or suspected information security events through appropriate channels in a timely manner.

requirements.title: Physical security perimeters
requirements.text: Define and use security perimeters to protect areas containing information and other associated assets.

requirements.title: Physical entry
requirements.text: Protect secure areas by appropriate entry controls and access points.

requirements.title: Securing offices, rooms and facilities
requirements.text: Design and implement physical security for offices, rooms and facilities.

requirements.title: Physical security monitoring
requirements.text: Continuously monitor premises for unauthorised physical access.

requirements.title: Protecting against physical and environmental threats
requirements.text: Design and implement protection against physical and environmental threats such as natural disasters and other intentional or unintentional threats to infrastructure.

requirements.title: Working in secure areas
requirements.text: Design and implement security measures for working in secure areas.

requirements.title: Clear desk and clear screen
requirements.text: Define and appropriately enforce clear desk rules for papers and removable storage media and clear screen rules for information processing facilities.

requirements.title: Equipment siting and protection
requirements.text: Site equipment securely and protect it.

requirements.title: Security of assets off-premises
requirements.text: Protect assets located off-premises.

requirements.title: Storage media
requirements.text: Manage storage media through their life cycle of acquisition, use, transportation and disposal in accordance with the classification scheme and handling requirements.

requirements.title: Supporting utilities
requirements.text: Protect information processing facilities from power failures and other disruptions caused by failures in supporting utilities.

requirements.title: Cabling security
requirements.text: Protect cables carrying power, data or supporting information services from interception, interference or damage.

requirements.title: Equipment maintenance
requirements.text: Maintain equipment correctly to ensure availability, integrity and confidentiality of information.

requirements.title: Secure disposal or re-use of equipment
requirements.text: Verify items of equipment containing storage media to ensure sensitive data and licensed software has been removed or securely overwritten before disposal or re-use.

requirements.title: User endpoint devices
requirements.text: Protect information stored on, processed by or accessible via user endpoint devices.

requirements.title: Privileged access rights
requirements.text: Restrict and manage the allocation and use of privileged access rights.

requirements.title: Information access restriction
requirements.text: Restrict access to information and other associated assets in accordance with the established access control policy.

requirements.title: Access to source code
requirements.text: Appropriately manage read and write access to source code, development tools and software libraries.

requirements.title: Secure authentication
requirements.text: Implement secure authentication technologies and procedures based on information access restrictions and the topic-specific policy on access control.

requirements.title: Capacity management
requirements.text: Monitor and adjust the use of resources in line with current and expected capacity requirements.

requirements.title: Protection against malware
requirements.text: Implement protection against malware, supported by appropriate user awareness.

requirements.title: Management of technical vulnerabilities
requirements.text: Obtain information about technical vulnerabilities of information systems in use, evaluate exposure and take appropriate measures.

requirements.title: Configuration management
requirements.text: Establish, document, implement, monitor and review configurations, including security configurations, of hardware, software, services and networks.

requirements.title: Information deletion
requirements.text: Delete information stored in information systems, devices or other storage media when no longer required.

requirements.title: Data masking
requirements.text: Use data masking in accordance with the topic-specific policy on access control, other related policies and business requirements, taking applicable law into account.

requirements.title: Data leakage prevention
requirements.text: Apply data leakage prevention measures to systems, networks and other devices that process, store or transmit sensitive information.

requirements.title: Information backup
requirements.text: Maintain and regularly test backup copies of information, software and systems in accordance with the agreed topic-specific policy on backup.

requirements.title: Redundancy of information processing facilities
requirements.text: Implement information processing facilities with sufficient redundancy to meet availability requirements.

requirements.title: Logging
requirements.text: Produce, store, protect and analyse logs that record activities, exceptions, faults and other relevant events.

requirements.title: Monitoring activities
requirements.text: Monitor networks, systems and applications for anomalous behaviour and take appropriate action to evaluate potential information security incidents.

requirements.title: Clock synchronisation
requirements.text: Synchronise the clocks of information processing systems to approved reference time sources.

requirements.title: Use of privileged utility programs
requirements.text: Restrict and tightly control the use of utility programs capable of overriding system and application controls.

requirements.title: Installation of software on operational systems
requirements.text: Implement procedures and measures to securely manage software installation on operational systems.

requirements.title: Networks security
requirements.text: Secure, manage and control networks and network devices to protect information in systems and applications.

requirements.title: Security of network services
requirements.text: Identify, implement and monitor security mechanisms, service levels and service requirements of network services.

requirements.title: Segregation of networks
requirements.text: Segregate groups of information services, users and information systems in the organization's networks.

requirements.title: Web filtering
requirements.text: Manage access to external websites to reduce exposure to malicious content.

requirements.title: Use of cryptography
requirements.text: Define and implement rules for the effective use of cryptography, including cryptographic key management.

requirements.title: Secure development life cycle
requirements.text: Establish and apply rules for the secure development of software and systems.

requirements.title: Application security requirements
requirements.text: Identify, specify and approve information security requirements when developing or acquiring applications.

requirements.title: Secure system architecture and engineering principles
requirements.text: Establish, document, maintain and apply principles for engineering secure systems to information system development activities.

requirements.title: Secure coding
requirements.text: Apply secure coding principles to software development.

requirements.title: Security testing in development and acceptance
requirements.text: Define and implement security testing processes in the development life cycle.

requirements.title: Outsourced development
requirements.text: Direct, monitor and review activities related to outsourced system development.

requirements.title: Separation of development, test and production environments
requirements.text: Separate and secure development, test and production environments.

requirements.title: Change management
requirements.text: Subject changes to information processing facilities and information systems to change management procedures.

requirements.title: Test information
requirements.text: Select, protect and manage test information appropriately.

requirements.title: Protection of information systems during audit testing
requirements.text: Plan and agree audit tests and other assurance activities involving assessment of operational systems between the tester and appropriate management.
